title: CHANNEL ANNOUNCEMENT + Some answers.
transcript_text: Hello fellow Robloxians, I'm here to announce my new secondary channel and some other questions, so number one. What's the channel called? Why I'm going to use it and will I stop using Bradley Bread? The channel is called Bradley, it's literally Bradley Bread without Bread, I'll be putting the link in the description. I'll be using Bradley to post devlogs or random stuff, while I'll post gameplays or animations in Bradley Bread. And no, as I said I'll still be active in Bradley Bread so if you want to subscribe to Bradley it would be very epic. Number two, are you still making script learning episodes? Yes, my first ever Bradley video will be one, so don't miss. Number three, why there is no 300 subscriber special? Because I'm still thinking on what there will be so yes there will be. Just be patient. Number four, why do I take so much time to make videos? Because on, I'm lazy. No just kidding it's because I'm lazy, I'm without ideas or I simply can't because I have no time. It may take a while to me to upload but I promise you I'll never stop. Number five is there a way to support me. When you watch my videos, you are already supporting me, but if you want to support more, comment and like the video. And subscribe to Bradley and Bradley Bread, or if you want to donate roadbooks, there's always a link in the description. The link goes to a game where you can donate to me, and by the way, a new way to donate to me is coming. I'm gonna make a Patreon account so if you want to donate actual money, you will be able to. I'm currently trying to buy a VR. But I can't afford it, so donations will help me get money and after I reach 1K subs I'll be able to monetize my videos. And yeah this is pretty much the video, if you have any other questions comment below. Thanks for 300 subs and goodbye.
